verdicts.title: Pause-freeze check flags Restart reset (by design)
verdicts.observed: After click:btn-restart while paused, timeLeft went 299 to 300 and enemy e2 moved, because the restart reset the level.
verdicts.expected: Restart puts the whole level back to its starting state, so resetting timer and enemies is intended. The check should exclude 'restart'. The real defect is that the game stays paused after restart (see candidate 1).

verdicts.title: Restart level leaves game paused with no pause menu; game is stuck
verdicts.observed: After pause then click:btn-restart, mode stays 'paused' with event 'restart', the pause menu (btn-resume, btn-restart) is not visible, and every following tick is a no-op with the state unchanged through tick 31.
verdicts.expected: Restart level resets the level (score 0, 3 lives, keys 0) and the game is running again straight away, mode 'playing', with the pause menu closed.

verdicts.title: Dash and step in the same tick both move the player (3 tiles)
verdicts.observed: Token dash-down+down moved the player from (1,1) to (1,4): events dash, coin, move. The player dashed 2 tiles and then stepped 1 more in one tick, and the dash cooldown was set to 5.
verdicts.expected: Only one move per tick: of the movement keys pressed in a tick, only the last one counts, so the player moves at most one tile (step) or one dash, not both.

verdicts.title: Toast covers the pause menu's Resume button
verdicts.observed: With the pause menu open after a key pickup, btn-resume reports top=false: the 'Key collected' toast sits on top of it, so a click on Resume would not reach the button.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it.

verdicts.title: Keys pressed after pause in the same tick still move the player
verdicts.observed: Token pause+left: the game paused, but the player still moved from (4,8) to (3,8) in that tick (events pause, move).
verdicts.expected: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing else happens in that tick, so the player should stay at (4,8).

verdicts.title: Score goes negative after spikes (-300)
verdicts.observed: Score jumped from 100 to 65136 on a dash tick, then fell to -300 after spikes and a coin on a later tick, showing HUD Score -300.
verdicts.expected: Score is never negative and is capped at 999,999; spikes subtract 500 but the score stops at 0. A score of 65136 from this sequence is also unexpected.

verdicts.title: HUD coin counter stays stale after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: After dash-down collects a coin at tick 0, state reports coins=1 and time=299, but HUD still shows 'Coins 0/5'. The HUD coin count does not update on the tick the coin is picked up, and remains stale on the following tick.
verdicts.expected: Section 8: the HUD always shows the current Coins n/5 value, so it should read 'Coins 1/5' immediately after the coin is collected.

verdicts.title: Spike damage at low score wraps the score around instead of flooring at 0
verdicts.observed: At tick 2 the player has score 100 and hits spikes. Score jumps to 65136 (the spike penalty of 500 wrapped to an unsigned 16-bit value, 65536-500+100). Later a coin/score update drives it to -300 at tick 5, so the score goes negative.
verdicts.expected: Section 4/5: spikes cost 500 points but the score stops at 0 and never goes below it. Score must never be negative or wrap; it should read 0 after the spike hit at tick 2, not 65136.

verdicts.title: HUD timer freezes at 290 while the game timer keeps counting down
verdicts.observed: After pause and click:btn-resume, the state timeLeft drops (290 -> 289 -> 288 ... -> 277) but the HUD keeps showing 'Time 290' from tick 11 to the end of the run.
verdicts.expected: Section 8: the HUD always shows the current Time (ticks left). After resume the HUD should track timeLeft each tick (e.g. 'Time 289', 'Time 288', ...).
